title: graphyard upgrade backs up the database before it moves the CLI, so a schema change upgrades
description: A local install whose server runs the release just before the newest schema generation (schema N) on its own Postgres upgrades to the tip (schema N+1): the backup runs first with the running release's CLI, then the checkout moves, the redeployed server migrates the database to N+1, and /healthz reports the new commit.

steps.name: Upgrade an install on schema N to a commit with schema N+1
